label: the mechanic's yard
note: Issue #95: Dorrin Vask's speeder yard, out in the desert about a 30 second drive from the back gate. Set in the world as a landmark (content/core/worlds/port_desert.json), so speeders collide with it and the player walks on it; src/systems/world/mechanic_yard.gd dresses it ('visual': false). Local frame: +x faces the town. Issue #295: the garage is wall pieces (back, two sides, a roof lifted by its position's y), open on +x, so a speeder drives in; the lift and the bay are inside it. 'points': where Dorrin stands at his bench, where you stand to talk, and the bay (the lift) where a speeder has to be parked for him to work on it (bay_radius in speeder_upgrades.json still reaches the sand out front).
